description: This file defines utility functions and constants for determining drop positions in a drag-and-drop interface within a dashboard layout, including handling of mouse position relative to component boundaries and validation of drop targets.

classes.name: DropTargetComponent
classes.description: Interface representing a drop target component with properties and optional reference to an HTML element.

methods.name: clearDropCache
methods.description: Clears the cached client offset data used during drag-and-drop operations.

methods.name: getDropPosition
methods.description: Calculates the drop position (top, right, bottom, left, forbidden) based on the current drag monitor state and the target component's properties.
